posts.author: Solitarian
posts.body:
I apologize if this is in the wrong place or if someone has already addressed this. I just downloaded RPG Maker MZ today and I got a tile set add on with it. When I load a new file up, it's not listed in the tile set, only the starting stuff. Where can I find it at and how can I access it?
Thanks in advance. I look forward to posting on here.

posts.author: SGHarlekin
posts.body:
Depending on where you got the tileset, it's gonna be either an extra download link (In case of the rm store)
Or it's going to be in your steam directory Steam\steamapps\common\RPG Maker MZ\dlc or wherever else you might have installed it.
You'll have to manually import these files too, they're not going to be automatically included in a new project.

posts.author: bgillisp
posts.body:
To add to that once you import it, go to the tileset tab, change maximum to something besides 4, and make a new tileset then with those new tiles.
I personally keep the original 4 tilesets on the tab for reference if nothing else, at least early in dev.

posts.author: TheAM-Dol
posts.body:
So the title is incorrect, since tilesets are not plugins. Those are two different things.
However, as SG Harlekin said, you would navigate to the download folder.
On steam you can right click the game in your library -> browse local files to quickly open the file browser. Navigate to the folder labelled dlc and you will find any purchases as well as all the freebies included with the purchase of RM.
You will then need to select and copy those files and past them to the correct location in your project;
tilesets go to the tileset folder, spritesheets go to the character folder, etc.
Finally, you will need to set up the tileset in your project by going to your database.
